layers.name: Presentation Layer
layers.description: Vue 3 frontend pages, layouts, and components served via Inertia.js. Handles all user-facing interfaces for service management, POS, inventory, reports, settings, and tools.

layers.name: Application Layer
layers.description: Laravel HTTP controllers handling request/response logic, validation, authorization, and orchestration. Includes tenant controllers, admin controllers, auth controllers, and API endpoints.

layers.name: Domain Layer
layers.description: Eloquent models representing business entities and database tables. Central models for tenants, plans, and billing. Tenant models for services, sales, inventory, customers, and all operational data.

layers.name: Infrastructure Layer
layers.description: System configuration, service providers, third-party integrations, and deployment setup. Includes tenancy config, filesystem, services, database, Vite/PWA, and event broadcasting.

layers.name: Quality Assurance Layer
layers.description: Automated tests: unit tests for models, form requests, and policies; feature tests for configuration and services.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: ServiceKU is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for Indonesian repair shop and retail management. Built with Laravel 11 + Vue 3 + Inertia.js. Each tenant gets an isolated database via stancl/tenancy.

tour.title: Multi-Tenancy Architecture
tour.description: Stancl tenancy with database-per-tenant isolation. The central DB holds tenants, plans, and billing. Each tenant has its own database with 40+ tables for services, sales, inventory, etc.

tour.title: Routes & Navigation
tour.description: Central web routes handle landing, registration, and superadmin. Tenant routes handle all business operations. A role-based menu system filters 20+ menu items through 4 authorization layers.

tour.title: Service Order Lifecycle
tour.description: The core business flow: service creation with device data → technician assignment → work progress → customer confirmation → pickup → warranty. Supports partner outsourcing, indents, and service transfers between branches.

tour.title: POS & Sales
tour.description: Point-of-sale system supporting direct sales, service-based billing, and indent pre-orders. Features draft workflow, PDF invoice generation, payment tracking, and void/return capability.

tour.title: Inventory & Supply Chain
tour.description: Full inventory management: product catalog, stock mutations, purchase orders, supplier management, stock transfers between branches, reorder alerts, and stock forecasting.

tour.title: Photo Upload & Google Drive
tour.description: Service and expense photos upload to Google Drive via OAuth. Photos stored locally first, then synced to tenant's own Google Drive. Upload disabled if Drive is not connected.

tour.title: Google Login & Authentication
tour.description: Google OAuth login via Socialite. Users can log in with Google or link/unlink Google accounts from their profile. Rate-limited login with login history tracking.

tour.title: HR & Operations
tour.description: Employee shift management, attendance tracking with clock in/out, technician commission auto-calculation, and pickup/delivery scheduling for customer devices.

tour.title: Reports & Analytics
tour.description: Comprehensive reporting: sales, services, inventory, finance, commissions, technician productivity scores, customer analytics with peak hours, and year-over-year revenue comparison.

tour.title: Super Admin Panel
tour.description: Central admin for managing all tenants: CRUD, suspend/activate, change plans, extend trials, impersonate login, reset passwords. Also manages subscription plans, backups, system settings, and monitoring.

tour.title: Subscriptions & Billing
tour.description: Tiered plans (Basic/Pro/Enterprise) with feature access control per business type. Voucher/promo system, trial management, and payment gateway integration (Midtrans/Xendit).

tour.title: Tools & Knowledge Management
tour.description: QR code scanner for service lookup, knowledge base for technician troubleshooting, SOPs with mandatory read tracking, quick replies for customer communication, and custom fields for extensibility.

tour.title: Quality Assurance
tour.description: 47 passing tests covering models, form requests, policies, application health, and Google Drive service. Tests use SQLite in-memory for fast execution.
